test_overview:
Evaluated the Team Sprint Board auth feature test plan (8 steps, 47 points max) against the running app at http://localhost:8000 using Playwright in strict test-plan order. All steps were executed and every verification — including all non-fatal sub-verifications — passed, resulting in a perfect score of 47/47.

Summary per step:
1. test_landing_page_shows_auth_options (4/4): Fresh context at the root shows the landing page (not the sprint board — board UI is not accessible unauthenticated). "Sign in"/"Sign up" options are present, plus text stating an invite code is required to create an account.
2. test_signup_validation_errors (7/7): Empty sign-up submit is blocked with per-field required errors and no authentication; user remains in the sign-up form with values retained. Wrong invite code `wrong-code-999` is blocked with an "Invalid invite code" field error while the user stays in the sign-up flow.
3. test_successful_signup_redirects_to_my_work (8/8): Re-entered full values (fields were retained — neither password nor name/email were cleared) with valid invite code `team-work-20225`. Sign-up succeeds and redirects to the "My Work" portal (not the board). Header shows "Hello, Alice Auth" (and nav for My Work / Open Team Board / Sign out), and a three-view selector exists: "Cards I created", "Cards assigned to me", "All my cards".
4. test_signup_rejects_duplicate_email (5/5): In a second context, signing up with duplicate email alice.auth@example.com and a valid invite code is rejected; the user is not signed in or redirected to the portal and remains on the sign-up form with error "An account with this email already exists".
5. test_sign_out_and_sign_in_flow (8/8): "Sign out" returns to the landing page with Sign up/Sign in options. Wrong-password sign-in is rejected (not authenticated, sign-in form remains) with error "Invalid email or password". Correct credentials sign in and redirect to My Work with header "Alice Auth".
6. test_open_team_board_from_my_work (5/5): With the "assigned to me" view selected, clicking "Open Team Board" opens the board without any "Enter your name" prompt. The board shows exactly four columns in order: Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done. The board header shows the signed-in user "Alice Auth" plus an "AA" avatar. BOARD_URL recorded as http://localhost:8000/ (SPA with no distinct board route; plan's commentary permits using the current URL).
7. test_board_to_my_work_preserves_view_selection (4/4): Clicking the board's "My Work" link returns to the My Work portal and the view selector remains on "Cards assigned to me".
8. test_unauthenticated_board_access_blocked (6/6): A fresh unauthenticated context navigating directly to BOARD_URL (the app root, since there is no distinct board deep link) cannot view the board; the landing/auth screen is rendered in-place offering both "Sign in" and "Sign up" options.

All verification logs were written to /app/_verification_logs/ and the tally was cross-checked before finishing. No application code was modified.

steps.description: test_landing_page_shows_auth_options: Landing page shown (board accessiblenot unauthenticated); 'Sign in'/'Sign up' options present; invite-code-required text present. All checks passed including non-fatal text check.

test_signup_validation_errors: Empty submit blocked with per-field required errors, no auth, sign-up flow retained; wrong invite code `wrong-code-999` blocked with 'Invalid invite code' error, flow retained. Non-fatal checks passed.

test_successful_signup_redirects_to_my_work: Valid sign-up with invite `team-work-20225` redirects to My Work portal; header shows 'Hello, Alice Auth' and nav (My Work/Open Team Board/Sign out); three-view selector present (Cards I created / Cards assigned to me / All my cards). Non-fatal checks passed.

test_signup_rejects_duplicate_email: Duplicate email sign-up rejected; user kept on sign-up form, not signed in/redirected; error 'An account with this email already exists' shown. Non-fatal check passed.

test_sign_out_and_sign_in_flow: Sign-out returns to landing with Sign up/Sign in; wrong-password sign-in rejected with 'Invalid email or password'; correct credentials redirect to My Work with 'Alice Auth' header. Non-fatal check passed.

test_open_team_board_from_my_work: 'assigned to me' view selected; 'Open Team Board' opens board with no name prompt; exactly 4 columns (Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done); 'Alice Auth' shown in board header identity area. BOARD_URL recorded (http://localhost:8000/, SPA).
test_board_to_my_work_preserves_view_selection: Board 'My Work' link returns to portal; view selector remains on 'Cards assigned to me'.
test_unauthenticated_board_access_blocked: Fresh unauthenticated context at BOARD_URL cannot view board; landing/auth UI rendered in-place offering both 'Sign in' and 'Sign up' options.
